accountDelete.title: Delete your Chatovo account
accountDelete.intro: You can delete your account yourself, from the app or on the web. No request form is needed.
accountDelete.step1: Sign in to Chatovo with the account you want to delete.
accountDelete.step3: Confirm through the link we email to the account address.
accountDelete.removed: Removed: your profile, avatar, the rooms you created, your friend list and your push notification devices.
accountDelete.kept: Your messages in shared rooms stay, without your name on them, so other people conversations are not torn apart. Backups roll over within 30 days.
